segments.sn42.5:1.1: Atha kho assāroho gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho assāroho gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.5:1.2: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ assārohānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.sn42.5:1.3: ‘yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’ti.
segments.sn42.5:1.5: “Alaṃ, gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
segments.sn42.5:2.2: tatiyampi kho assāroho gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.5:2.3: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ assārohānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.sn42.5:2.4: ‘yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’ti.
segments.sn42.5:3.2: ‘alaṃ, gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī’ti.
segments.sn42.5:3.4: Yo so, gāmaṇi, assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe gahitaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ –
segments.sn42.5:3.5: ‘ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā ahesuṃ iti vā’ti.
segments.sn42.5:3.6: Tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajito nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati.
segments.sn42.5:3.7: Sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti –
segments.sn42.5:3.8: ‘yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’ti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
segments.sn42.5:3.9: Micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi, purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi –
segments.sn42.5:4.1: Evaṃ vutte, assāroho gāmaṇi parodi, assūni pavattesi.
segments.sn42.5:4.3: ‘alaṃ, gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī’”ti.
segments.sn42.5:4.4: “Nāhaṃ, bhante, etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha.
segments.sn42.5:4.5: Apicāhaṃ, bhante, pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi assārohehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paluddho –
segments.sn42.5:4.6: ‘yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’”ti.

lines: 355-357. Tatiye yodhājīvoti yuddhena jīvikaṃ kappanako dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi evaṃ gahitanāmo.
Parajito nāma nirayoti ayampi na visuṃ eko nirayo, avīcisseva pana ekasmiṃ koṭṭhāse pañcāvudhasannaddhā phalakahatthā hatthiassarathe āruyha saṅgāme yujjhantā viya paccanti, taṃ sandhāyetaṃ vuttaṃ.
“yuddhena jīvikaṃ kappanako”ti, ussāhaṃ vāyāmaṃ karotīti yujjhanavasena ussāhaṃ vāyāmaṃ karoti.
Duṭṭhu ṭhapitanti duṭṭhākārena attano paresañca atthāvahabhāvaṃ na gataṃ paṭipannaṃ.
Parehi saṅgāme jitā hatā ettha jāyantīti parajito nāma nirayo.
Eseva nayoti eso tatiye vutto eva atthato visesābhāvato.
